laws.rule: Smartraveller says the roads around the President's official residence (State House, Chancellor Avenue, The Avenues, Harare) are closed between 6 pm and 6 am. It says security there is strict: don't look through the gates or hang around outside the walls, and don't rely on GPS around the area.
laws.heading: Smartraveller travel advice

laws.rule: Zimbabwe Museum of Human Sciences: ordinary gallery visitors may use a guide or tour on their own. Outside researchers need Regional Director/Librarian approval to use the specialist library; the museum says it is not a public library. Do not confuse optional gallery guidance with unrestricted access to research collections.
